full_judgment: 9. Having gone through the entire order dated 23-6-2008 delivered by the learned District Judge, it appears that he has not stated anywhere that the delay has been condoned in respect of the final decree only. The entire order reveals that the appeal has been admitted against both the preliminary decree and the final decree. The learned District Judge committed a clerical mistake while converting years and days into days. Such a clerical mistake cannot stand on the way of getting the desired relief by respondent Nos.1 and 2. The learned District Judge was, however, satisfied with the explanation furnished by respondent Nos. 1 and 2 in the application filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act.
